---
title: "Tutorial"
description: "A linear SCNSim micro-course from primitive authoring to Direct, optimization, reusable composition, and pump-off HB."
---

Follow the course in order. Each page answers one user question in **3–5
minutes**, including reading and submitting its code; solver, optimization, and
HB wait time is excluded. If an API has not been taught, the course does not
use it.

::: {.callout-warning title="Candidate package" appearance="simple"}
SCNSim remains `CONVERGING`. The course expresses the intended native V1 API,
but the current package is a fail-fast scaffold and produces no simulation
evidence.
:::

## Author and analyze

::: {.card .card-body .mb-3}
### [1. Author one primitive reflective circuit](../examples/tutorials/01_author_primitive.qmd)

**Question:** How do I state every component and electrical connection once?
**Time:** 3–5 minutes · compute wait excluded
**Produces:** an inspectable authoring schematic.
:::

::: {.card .card-body .mb-3}
### [2. Prepare a Direct request](../examples/tutorials/02_prepare_direct.qmd)

**Question:** How do I choose a view and response request without solving?
**Time:** 3–5 minutes · compute wait excluded
**Produces:** deterministic preflight evidence.
:::

::: {.card .card-body .mb-3}
### [3. Solve a Direct response](../examples/tutorials/03_solve_direct.qmd)

**Question:** How do I obtain S/Y/Z and one named trace?
**Time:** 3–5 minutes · compute wait excluded
**Produces:** a typed `DirectSolveResult`.
:::

::: {.card .card-body .mb-3}
### [4. Evaluate one physical quantity](../examples/tutorials/04_evaluate_quantity.qmd)

**Question:** How do I find a resonance without an unrelated response sweep?
**Time:** 3–5 minutes · compute wait excluded
**Produces:** a typed diagonal-root Result.
:::

::: {.card .card-body .mb-3}
### [5. Optimize a primitive parameter](../examples/tutorials/05_optimize_primitive.qmd)

**Question:** Can I optimize before packaging a Composite?
**Time:** 3–5 minutes · compute wait excluded
**Produces:** an optimization Result and immutable best `ParameterSet`.
:::

::: {.card .card-body .mb-3}
### [6. Report and resolve exact Results](../examples/tutorials/06_report_resolve.qmd)

**Question:** How do I report explicit evidence and reload it after restart?
**Time:** 3–5 minutes · compute wait excluded
**Produces:** a report and exact receipt-backed resolution path.
:::
